title: Compute impurity-dressed Raman spectra for d-wave superconductor
action: Implement the non-resonant Raman response formula for a d‑wave gap on a cylindrical Fermi surface, including T‑matrix impurity self‑energy for s‑wave scatterers. Evaluate the Matsubara sum and momentum integration numerically for the clean limit (no impurities) and for the unitary impurity limit (cotangent of scattering phase shift c=0). Produce spectra for the B1g, B2g, and A1g symmetry channels. Output a CSV file with columns: frequency (in units of Δ0), channel, impurity_type, Gamma_over_Delta0, intensity.
description: Frequency‑resolved Raman intensity for three symmetry channels and two impurity limits (clean and unitary). The checker will recompute peak positions and low‑frequency power‑law exponents from this raw data.
output_schema: frequency: float (in units of Δ0), channel: str (one of B1g, B2g, A1g), impurity_type: str (one of clean, unitary), Gamma_over_Delta0: float, intensity: float (arbitrary units)

title: Compute B1g Raman spectrum with inelastic self-energy
action: Extend the model by including a phenomenological inelastic self‑energy. Compute the B1g channel Raman response using a small unitary impurity scattering rate. Output a CSV file with columns: frequency (in units of Δ0) and intensity.
description: Raman intensity for the B1g channel with added inelastic scattering, demonstrating a flat high‑frequency tail. The checker will recompute the high‑frequency power‑law decay from this raw data.
output_schema: frequency: float (in units of Δ0), intensity: float (arbitrary units)
